name: Orchidaceae

children.name: Bulbophyllum
children.desc: Bulbophyllum is a genus of mostly epiphytic and lithophytic orchids in the family Orchidaceae.

children.name: Dendrobium
children.desc: Dendrobium is a genus of mostly epiphytic and lithophytic orchids in the family Orchidaceae.

children.name: Epidendrum
children.desc: Epidendrum, abbreviated Epi in the horticultural trade, is a large neotropical genus of the orchid family.

children.name: Habenaria
children.desc: Habenaria, commonly called rein orchids or bog orchids, is a widely distributed genus of orchids in the tribe Orchideae.

children.name: Lepanthes
children.desc: Lepanthes (from Greek "scaled-flower") is a large genus of orchids with about 800–1000 species, distributed in the Antilles and from Mexico through Bolivia (with very few species in Brazil).

children.name: Masdevallia
children.desc: Masdevallia, abbreviated Masd in horticultural trade, is a large genus of flowering plants of the Pleurothallidinae, a subtribe of the orchid family (Orchidaceae).

children.name: Maxillaria
children.desc: Maxillaria, abbreviated as Max in the horticultural trade, is a large genus of orchids (family Orchidaceae).

children.name: Stelis

children.desc: Stelis, or leach orchids, are a large genus of orchids, with 1339 accepted species.

desc: Orchids are plants that belong to the family Orchidaceae, a diverse and widespread group of flowering plants with blooms that are often colourful and fragrant.
